trust_decision.summary: In multi-tenant mode, a request whose instance context lacks either n8nApiUrl or n8nApiKey derives the empty '' scope id (the single-tenant/default scope) and must not read/delete/prune/rollback the workflow_versions rows of that scope; decided at the POST /mcp header gate and in handleWorkflowVersions, with the scope derived by getInstanceScopeId.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'workflow version backups'; handleWorkflowVersions is the n8n_workflow_versions tool handler that builds WorkflowVersioningService with getInstanceScopeId(context).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /mcp (multi-tenant header gate; changed && to || so url-only or key-only is rejected)
MCP tool n8n_workflow_versions (dispatch src/mcp/server.ts:1657), reached from POST /mcp, N8NMCPEngine.processRequest and restored sessions
fix_sites.module_kind: tool handler (fail-closed when ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT and scope id is '')

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/mcp-engine.ts:72-78 (N8NMCPEngine.processRequest passes a caller-built instanceContext straight to SingleSessionHTTPServer.handleRequest at src/http-server-single-session.ts:531, bypassing the header gate at :1341); also restoreSessionState src/http-server-single-session.ts:1732-1758 accepts a partial context because validateInstanceContext treats each field as optional (src/types/instance-context.ts:140,163). Only the handler-level check at src/mcp/handlers-n8n-manager.ts:2407 closes these.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about tenant headers on the HTTP server; the embedding library API (processRequest / restoreSessionState) documents that 'the wrapping service handles authentication, multi-tenancy' (src/mcp-engine.ts:52-53), so a solver can argue that context completeness is the embedder's job and only tighten the header check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Single-user / stdio / non-multi-tenant HTTP deployments legitimately use the '' scope for their own backups (list/get/rollback must keep working); an over-broad fix that rejects the '' scope unconditionally, or rejects any missing context, breaks them. Full url+key tenants must also keep their own scoped backups.

O6_input_shapes: no context / undefined context at the handler in multi-tenant mode
all handler modes: list, get, rollback, delete (single and deleteAll), prune

O7_producer.where: src/types/instance-context.ts:223-231 (getInstanceScopeId maps an incomplete context to the '' default scope)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An automatic rollback-on-failure in n8n_update_partial_workflow that reads getLatestWorkflowVersion via WorkflowVersioningService(getInstanceScopeId(context)) without the multi-tenant '' scope guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handler already constructs the versioning service here and its failure message points users to backups (src/mcp/handlers-workflow-diff.ts:437); auto-restore is a natural feature added in another file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A storage-stats field in n8n_health_check/diagnostic built from getStorageStats with the request's scope id, exposing default-scope counts/sizes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getVersionStorageStats exists in the service but is not exposed; a maintainer could surface it in the diagnostic handler (src/mcp/handlers-n8n-manager.ts:2384-2398) without thinking of the tenant guard.

O9_family: CWE-863 incorrect authorization / tenant isolation (default-scope fallback for incomplete tenant credentials), CWE-200 information exposure

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm, tsc (package.json:18), vitest (package.json:37); better-sqlite3 native module (package.json:181) with sql.js fallback (package.json:173)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/integration/security/ghsa-j6r7-workflow-versions.test.ts (handler tenant isolation, in-memory DB) and tests/unit/http-server/ssrf-gate.test.ts (multi-tenant header omission on POST /mcp with mocked req/res)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the POST /mcp header gate from '!hasUrl && !hasKey' to '!hasUrl || !hasKey' only, leaving the engine API and restored sessions able to reach the '' scope through handleWorkflowVersions.

out_of_scope_notes: deleteWorkflowVersionsOlderThan is not tenant-scoped (src/database/node-repository.ts:1240-1242); retention cleanup, by design, not pursued.

Write paths (update/partial-update backups) also use getInstanceScopeId but need an API client, which is null for incomplete contexts in multi-tenant mode (src/mcp/handlers-n8n-manager.ts:343-346); not pursued.
